TH-01.line: Leave it there and the list of things you have stopped doing keeps growing.
TH-01.heard: leave it there and the list of things you have stopped doing keeps growing

TH-02.line: Here is what I have watched fail for thirty years.

TH-03.line: that was not you failing. You were wrapping the wrong part of your leg.

TH-04.line: You do not wrap the joint. You go under it. Three things have to be right.

TH-05.line: Do not take my word for it. One knee only. Leave the other bare.

TH-06.line: Not because the arthritis is gone. Because the force is not landing where it hurts.
